requirements.title: LGE STRING_A and STRING_B argument restrictions
requirements.definition: STRING_A shall be default character or ASCII character, and STRING_B shall be character with the same kind type parameter as STRING_A.

pending.LGE-STRING_A-default-or-ASCII-character: Positive source plan calls LGE with default character operands containing only ASCII characters; source-control mutation changes STRING_A to integer and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.LGE-STRING_B-same-character-kind-as-STRI: Positive source plan uses same-kind character operands; source-control mutation changes STRING_B kind and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LGE pads the shorter string with blanks before comparison
requirements.definition: For unequal lengths, LGE compares as though the shorter string were extended on the right with blanks to the longer length.

pending.LGE-blank-padding-shorter-left: Assert LGE("A","A!") is false because the left operand compares as "A "; mutate the right operand to "A " so the padding distinction is load-bearing.
pending.LGE-blank-padding-shorter-right: Assert LGE("A!","A") is true because the right operand compares as "A "; reverse operands to fail the direction check.

requirements.title: LGE is true for equality or ASCII following, false otherwise
requirements.definition: For ASCII operands, LGE is true for equal strings or STRING_A following STRING_B in the ASCII collating sequence, and false otherwise.

pending.LGE-equal-strings-true: Use equal ASCII operands "Az" and "Az" with result sentinel .false.; mutate intrinsic to LGT so equality fails.
pending.LGE-following-true: Use ASCII-discriminating following pairs with result sentinel .false.: LGE("A","9"), LGE("a","Z"), LGE("a","A"), and LGE("_","Z") all true from ASCII codes '9'=57, 'A'=65, 'Z'=90, '_'=95, 'a'=97; include each reverse as a false companion so native collation cannot satisfy the plan.
pending.LGE-preceding-false: Use ASCII-discriminating preceding pairs with result sentinel .true.: LGE("9","A"), LGE("Z","a"), LGE("A","a"), and LGE("Z","_") all false from ASCII codes '9'=57, 'A'=65, 'Z'=90, '_'=95, 'a'=97; include each reverse as a true companion.
